---- MODULE CahillSerializability ----
EXTENDS CahillSerializabilityDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgentTLAPS == INSTANCE TLAPS
LOCAL AgentSeqThm == INSTANCE SequenceTheorems
AgentEventSet == ([op:{"begin"}, txnid:TxnId] \cup [op:{"commit"}, txnid:TxnId] \cup [op:{"abort"}, txnid:TxnId, reason:STRING] \cup [op:{"read"}, txnid:TxnId, key:Key, ver:TxnId] \cup [op:{"write"}, txnid:TxnId, key:Key])
AgentHasBegin(h) == \A t \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(h) : \E i \in 1..Len(h) : h[i] = [op |-> "begin", txnid |-> t]
AgentHistOK == /\ history \in Seq(AgentEventSet)
               /\ AgentHasBegin(history)
AgentInv == /\ AgentHistOK
            /\ CahillSerializable(history)
LEMMA AgentSelectAppend == ASSUME NEW S, NEW s \in Seq(S), NEW e \in S, NEW C
                          PROVE SelectSeq(Append(s, e), LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in C) = IF e.txnid \in C THEN Append(SelectSeq(s, LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in C), e) ELSE SelectSeq(s, LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in C)
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r20")
LEMMA AgentGeneralCT == ASSUME NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW e \in AgentEventSet, e.op # "commit"
                       PROVE CommittedTxns(Append(h, e)) = CommittedTxns(h)
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r20") DEF CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range, AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentGeneralCH == ASSUME NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW e \in AgentEventSet, e.op # "commit", e.txnid \notin CommittedTxns(h)
                       PROVE SelectSeq(Append(h, e), LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in CommittedTxns(Append(h, e))) = SelectSeq(h, LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in CommittedTxns(h))
<1>1. CommittedTxns(Append(h, e)) = CommittedTxns(h) BY AgentGeneralCT DEF AgentEventSet
<1>2. e \in AgentEventSet OBVIOUS
<1>3. e.txnid \notin CommittedTxns(h) OBVIOUS
<1>4. SelectSeq(Append(h, e), LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in CommittedTxns(h)) = SelectSeq(h, LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in CommittedTxns(h))
  BY <1>2, <1>3, AgentSelectAppend, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>5. QED BY <1>1, <1>4 DEF CommittedTxns
LEMMA AgentGeneralKeys == ASSUME NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW e \in AgentEventSet, NEW T1, NEW op, T1 \in CommittedTxns(h), e.txnid # T1
                         PROVE KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(Append(h, e), T1, op) = KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h, T1, op)
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r20") DEF KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn, SelectEvents, Range, AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentGeneralMVSG == ASSUME NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW e \in AgentEventSet, e.op # "commit", e.txnid \notin CommittedTxns(h)
                         PROVE CahillMVSG(Append(h, e)) = CahillMVSG(h)
<1>1. CommittedTxns(Append(h, e)) = CommittedTxns(h) BY AgentGeneralCT DEF AgentEventSet
<1>2. SelectSeq(Append(h, e), LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in CommittedTxns(Append(h, e))) = SelectSeq(h, LAMBDA x : x.txnid \in CommittedTxns(h)) BY AgentGeneralCH DEF AgentEventSet
<1>3. \A T1 \in CommittedTxns(h) : \A o : KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(Append(h, e), T1, o) = KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h, T1, o)
  <2>1. ASSUME NEW T1 \in CommittedTxns(h), NEW o PROVE KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(Append(h, e), T1, o) = KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn(h, T1, o)
    <3>1. e.txnid # T1 BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range, AgentEventSet
    <3>2. QED BY <3>1, AgentGeneralKeys DEF AgentEventSet
  <2>2. QED BY <2>1
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3 DEF CahillMVSG
LEMMA AgentCommittedSubset == ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(AgentEventSet) PROVE CommittedTxns(s) \subseteq TxnId
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r15") DEF CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range, AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentStartTimeValid == ASSUME NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW txn \in TxnId, AgentHasBegin(h), txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(h), history = h
                            PROVE /\ StartTime(history, txn) \in 1..Len(history)
                                  /\ history[StartTime(history, txn)] = [op |-> "begin", txnid |-> txn]
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r20") DEF StartTime, AgentHasBegin, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, SelectEvents, Range, AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentSubSeqHist == ASSUME NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW txn \in TxnId, AgentHasBegin(h), txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(h), history = h
                        PROVE SubSeq(history, 1, StartTime(history, txn)) \in Seq(AgentEventSet)
<1>1. StartTime(history, txn) \in 1..Len(history) BY AgentStartTimeValid DEF AgentEventSet
<1>2. \A i \in 1..StartTime(history, txn) : history[i] \in AgentEventSet BY <1>1, AgentSeqThm!ElementOfSeq, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AgentSeqThm!SubSeqProperties, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentSelectSeqType == ASSUME NEW s \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW k \in Key PROVE SelectSeq(s, LAMBDA e : e.op = "write" /\ e.key = k /\ e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(s)) \in Seq(AgentEventSet)
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r20") DEF AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentLatestSubset == ASSUME NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW k \in Key, AgentHasBegin(h), txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(h), history = h
                          PROVE LatestCommittedVersionOfKeyWhenTxnBegan(txn, k) \subseteq TxnId
<1>1. SubSeq(history, 1, StartTime(history, txn)) \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY AgentSubSeqHist DEF AgentEventSet
<1>2. CommittedTxns(SubSeq(history, 1, StartTime(history, txn))) \subseteq TxnId BY <1>1, AgentCommittedSubset DEF AgentEventSet
<1>3. SelectSeq(SubSeq(history, 1, StartTime(history, txn)), LAMBDA e : e.op = "write" /\ e.key = k /\ e.txnid \in CommittedTxns(SubSeq(history, 1, StartTime(history, txn)))) \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY <1>1, AgentSelectSeqType DEF AgentEventSet
<1>4. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r20") DEF LatestCommittedVersionOfKeyWhenTxnBegan, CommittedWriteHistoryOfKey, AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentReadVerSubset == ASSUME NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW k \in Key, NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), AgentHasBegin(h), txn \in ActiveTxns(h), history = h
                           PROVE VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(txn, k) \subseteq TxnId
<1>1. txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(h) BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range, AgentEventSet
<1>2. LatestCommittedVersionOfKeyWhenTxnBegan(txn, k) \subseteq TxnId BY <1>1, AgentLatestSubset DEF AgentEventSet
<1>3. QED BY <1>2, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r15") DEF VersionThatWouldBeReadBy, KeysCurrentlyXLockedByActiveTxn, AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentHasBeginPreserved == ASSUME NEW h \in Seq(AgentEventSet), NEW e \in AgentEventSet, NEW h2, h2 = Append(h, e), AgentHasBegin(h), (e.op = "begin" => e.txnid \notin ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(h)) /\ (e.op # "begin" => e.txnid \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(h))
                               PROVE AgentHasBegin(h2)
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r25") DEF AgentHasBegin, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, SelectEvents, Range, AgentEventSet
LEMMA AgentInitHistOK == Init => AgentHistOK
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r15") DEF Init, AgentHistOK, AgentEventSet, AgentHasBegin, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
LEMMA AgentInitSerial == Init => CahillSerializable(history)
BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r15") DEF Init, CahillSerializable, CahillMVSG, IsCycle, FindAllNodesInAnyCycle, CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, AbortedTxns, FinalizedTxns, ActiveTxns, KeysThatTxnHasDoneOperationOn, IndexOfOpInHistory
LEMMA AgentBeginPresInv == ASSUME NEW txn \in TxnId, AgentInv, Begin(txn) PROVE AgentInv'
<1>1. history \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>2. AgentHasBegin(history) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>3. CahillSerializable(history) BY DEF AgentInv
<1>4. [op |-> "begin", txnid |-> txn] \in AgentEventSet BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r5") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>5. history' = Append(history, [op |-> "begin", txnid |-> txn]) BY DEF Begin
<1>6. txn \notin ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(history) BY DEF Begin
<1>7. history' \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, AgentSeqThm!AppendProperties DEF AgentEventSet
<1>8. AgentHasBegin(history') BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, AgentHasBeginPreserved DEF AgentEventSet
<1>9. AgentHistOK' BY <1>7, <1>8 DEF AgentHistOK
<1>10. txn \notin CommittedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, SelectEvents, Range, AgentEventSet
<1>11. CahillMVSG(history') = CahillMVSG(history) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, <1>10, AgentGeneralMVSG DEF AgentEventSet
<1>12. CahillSerializable(history') BY <1>3, <1>11 DEF CahillSerializable
<1>13. QED BY <1>9, <1>12 DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
LEMMA AgentChooseAbortPresInv == ASSUME NEW txn \in TxnId, AgentInv, ChooseToAbort(txn) PROVE AgentInv'
<1>1. history \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>2. AgentHasBegin(history) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>3. CahillSerializable(history) BY DEF AgentInv
<1>4. [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> txn, reason |-> "voluntary"] \in AgentEventSet BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r5") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>5. history' = Append(history, [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> txn, reason |-> "voluntary"]) BY DEF ChooseToAbort, internalAbort
<1>6. txn \in ActiveTxns(history) BY DEF ChooseToAbort, StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation
<1>7. txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>8. history' \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, AgentSeqThm!AppendProperties DEF AgentEventSet
<1>9. AgentHasBegin(history') BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>7, AgentHasBeginPreserved DEF AgentEventSet
<1>10. AgentHistOK' BY <1>8, <1>9 DEF AgentHistOK
<1>11. txn \notin CommittedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>12. CahillMVSG(history') = CahillMVSG(history) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, <1>11, AgentGeneralMVSG DEF AgentEventSet
<1>13. CahillSerializable(history') BY <1>3, <1>12 DEF CahillSerializable
<1>14. QED BY <1>10, <1>13 DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
LEMMA AgentReadAbortPresInv == ASSUME NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW key \in Key, AgentInv, Read(txn, key), (\E xNew \in VersionIDsOfKeyNewerThanReadByTxn(txn, key) : xNew \in CommittedTxns(history) /\ outConflict[xNew]) PROVE AgentInv'
<1>1. history \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>2. AgentHasBegin(history) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>3. CahillSerializable(history) BY DEF AgentInv
<1>4. [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> txn, reason |-> "in attempted read, to preserve serializability"] \in AgentEventSet BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r5") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>5. history' = Append(history, [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> txn, reason |-> "in attempted read, to preserve serializability"]) BY DEF Read, internalAbort, VersionThatWouldBeReadBy, VersionIDsOfKeyNewerThanReadByTxn
<1>6. txn \in ActiveTxns(history) BY DEF Read, StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation
<1>7. txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>8. history' \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, AgentSeqThm!AppendProperties DEF AgentEventSet
<1>9. AgentHasBegin(history') BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>7, AgentHasBeginPreserved DEF AgentEventSet
<1>10. AgentHistOK' BY <1>8, <1>9 DEF AgentHistOK
<1>11. txn \notin CommittedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>12. CahillMVSG(history') = CahillMVSG(history) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, <1>11, AgentGeneralMVSG DEF AgentEventSet
<1>13. CahillSerializable(history') BY <1>3, <1>12 DEF CahillSerializable
<1>14. QED BY <1>10, <1>13 DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
LEMMA AgentReadSuccessPresInv == ASSUME NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW key \in Key, AgentInv, Read(txn, key), ~(\E xNew \in VersionIDsOfKeyNewerThanReadByTxn(txn, key) : xNew \in CommittedTxns(history) /\ outConflict[xNew]) PROVE AgentInv'
<1>1. history \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>2. AgentHasBegin(history) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>3. CahillSerializable(history) BY DEF AgentInv
<1>4. txn \in ActiveTxns(history) BY DEF Read, StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation
<1>5. VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(txn, key) \subseteq TxnId BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, AgentReadVerSubset DEF AgentHistOK
<1>6. VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(txn, key) # {} BY DEF Read
<1>7. (CHOOSE ver \in VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(txn, key) : TRUE) \in TxnId BY <1>5, <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>8. [op |-> "read", txnid |-> txn, key |-> key, ver |-> (CHOOSE ver \in VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(txn, key) : TRUE)] \in AgentEventSet BY <1>7, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>9. history' = Append(history, [op |-> "read", txnid |-> txn, key |-> key, ver |-> (CHOOSE ver \in VersionThatWouldBeReadBy(txn, key) : TRUE)]) BY DEF Read, internalAbort, VersionThatWouldBeReadBy, VersionIDsOfKeyNewerThanReadByTxn
<1>10. txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(history) BY <1>4, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>11. history' \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY <1>1, <1>8, <1>9, AgentSeqThm!AppendProperties DEF AgentEventSet
<1>12. AgentHasBegin(history') BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>8, <1>9, <1>10, AgentHasBeginPreserved DEF AgentEventSet
<1>13. AgentHistOK' BY <1>11, <1>12 DEF AgentHistOK
<1>14. txn \notin CommittedTxns(history) BY <1>4, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>15. CahillMVSG(history') = CahillMVSG(history) BY <1>1, <1>8, <1>9, <1>14, AgentGeneralMVSG DEF AgentEventSet
<1>16. CahillSerializable(history') BY <1>3, <1>15 DEF CahillSerializable
<1>17. QED BY <1>13, <1>16 DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
LEMMA AgentCommitAbortPresInv == ASSUME NEW txn \in TxnId, AgentInv, Commit(txn), inConflict[txn] /\ outConflict[txn] PROVE AgentInv'
<1>1. history \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>2. AgentHasBegin(history) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>3. CahillSerializable(history) BY DEF AgentInv
<1>4. [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> txn, reason |-> "in attempted commit, to preserve serializability"] \in AgentEventSet BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r5") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>5. history' = Append(history, [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> txn, reason |-> "in attempted commit, to preserve serializability"]) BY DEF Commit, internalAbort
<1>6. txn \in ActiveTxns(history) BY DEF Commit, StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation
<1>7. txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>8. history' \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, AgentSeqThm!AppendProperties DEF AgentEventSet
<1>9. AgentHasBegin(history') BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>7, AgentHasBeginPreserved DEF AgentEventSet
<1>10. AgentHistOK' BY <1>8, <1>9 DEF AgentHistOK
<1>11. txn \notin CommittedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>12. CahillMVSG(history') = CahillMVSG(history) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, <1>11, AgentGeneralMVSG DEF AgentEventSet
<1>13. CahillSerializable(history') BY <1>3, <1>12 DEF CahillSerializable
<1>14. QED BY <1>10, <1>13 DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
LEMMA AgentStutterPresInv == ASSUME AgentInv, UNCHANGED allvars PROVE AgentInv'
BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK, AgentHasBegin, CahillSerializable, allvars
LEMMA AgentWriteFCWPresInv == ASSUME NEW txn \in TxnId, NEW key \in Key, AgentInv, StartWriteMayBlock(txn, key), WritersCommittedToKeySinceTxnBegan(txn, key) # {} PROVE AgentInv'
<1>1. history \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>2. AgentHasBegin(history) BY DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
<1>3. CahillSerializable(history) BY DEF AgentInv
<1>4. [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> txn, reason |-> "forced by First Committer Wins"] \in AgentEventSet BY AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r5") DEF AgentEventSet
<1>5. history' = Append(history, [op |-> "abort", txnid |-> txn, reason |-> "forced by First Committer Wins"]) BY DEF StartWriteMayBlock
<1>6. txn \in ActiveTxns(history) BY DEF StartWriteMayBlock, StartedAndCanDoPublicOperation
<1>7. txn \in ActiveOrFinalizedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>8. history' \in Seq(AgentEventSet) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, AgentSeqThm!AppendProperties DEF AgentEventSet
<1>9. AgentHasBegin(history') BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>4, <1>5, <1>7, AgentHasBeginPreserved DEF AgentEventSet
<1>10. AgentHistOK' BY <1>8, <1>9 DEF AgentHistOK
<1>11. txn \notin CommittedTxns(history) BY <1>6, AgentTLAPS!SMTT("r10") DEF ActiveTxns, ActiveOrFinalizedTxns, FinalizedTxns, CommittedTxns, AbortedTxns, SelectEvents, Range
<1>12. CahillMVSG(history') = CahillMVSG(history) BY <1>1, <1>4, <1>5, <1>11, AgentGeneralMVSG DEF AgentEventSet
<1>13. CahillSerializable(history') BY <1>3, <1>12 DEF CahillSerializable
<1>14. QED BY <1>10, <1>13 DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM CahillSerializableCorrect == Spec => []CahillSerializable(history)
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF CahillSSI/CahillSerializability_CahillSerializableCorrect.tla
<1>1. Init => AgentInv BY AgentInitHistOK, AgentInitSerial DEF AgentInv
<1>2. AgentInv /\ [Next]_allvars => AgentInv' BY AgentBeginPresInv, AgentChooseAbortPresInv, AgentReadAbortPresInv, AgentReadSuccessPresInv, AgentCommitAbortPresInv, AgentStutterPresInv, AgentWriteFCWPresInv DEF AgentInv, AgentHistOK, Next, allvars, Begin, Commit, ChooseToAbort, Read, StartWriteMayBlock, FinishBlockedWrite, LegitimateTermination, internalAbort, VersionThatWouldBeReadBy, VersionIDsOfKeyNewerThanReadByTxn
<1>3. QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AgentTLAPS!PTL DEF Spec, Init, Next, allvars, AgentInv, CahillSerializable
\* END AGENT PROOF CahillSSI/CahillSerializability_CahillSerializableCorrect.tla
====
